translations.en: You can hold this for a moment.
translations.ja: これをちょっと持ってて。

tokens.explanation: 2nd person singular nominative personal pronoun functioning as the subject.
Finite 2nd person singular present of the modal auxiliary, selecting a bare infinitive (festhalten).
Demonstrative/personal pronoun functioning as the accusative object.
Adverb modifying the verbal action, indicating a short duration.
Separable-prefix verb in bare infinitive (due to modal); not split here. Core lexical verb meaning ‘hold tight/retain’.

sentences.target: Ich will mich am Geländer festhalten.

translations.de: Ich will mich am Geländer festhalten.
translations.en: I want to hold on to the railing.
translations.fr: Je veux me tenir à la barre.
translations.vi: Tôi muốn bám vào tay vịn.
translations.nl: Ik wil me aan de stang vasthouden.
translations.el: Θέλω να κρατηθώ από το κάγκελο.
translations.nb: Jeg vil holde meg i stangen.
translations.id: Aku ingin berpegangan pada pegangan tangan.
translations.ro: Vreau să mă țin de bară.
translations.da: Jeg vil holde fast i rækværket.
translations.ja: 手すりにつかまりたい。

tokens.explanation: 1st person singular nominative personal pronoun functioning as the subject.
Finite 1st person singular present of the modal auxiliary, selecting a bare infinitive (festhalten).
1st person singular reflexive pronoun in accusative, required by the reflexive use of ‘sich festhalten’.
Preposition (contraction of ‘an dem’) governing dative, introducing a PP complement for location (‘am Geländer’).
Neuter noun in dative as object of the preposition ‘am’; denotes the thing one holds onto.
Separable-prefix verb in bare infinitive (due to modal); reflexive construction with ‘mich’ and PP ‘am Geländer’.

translations.en: He wants to hold the ladder steady.
translations.es: Quiere sujetar la escalera para que no se mueva.
translations.fr: Il veut tenir l’échelle pour la stabiliser.
translations.ru: Он хочет придерживать лестницу, чтобы она не шаталась.
translations.pt: Ele quer segurar a escada para ela não balançar.
translations.he: הוא רוצה להחזיק את הסולם יציב.
translations.vi: Anh ấy muốn giữ cái thang cho vững.
translations.ar: هو يريد أن يمسك السلم حتى لا يهتز.
translations.nl: Hij wil de ladder stevig vasthouden.
translations.uk: Він хоче тримати драбину, щоб вона не хиталася.
translations.hi: वह सीढ़ी को स्थिर रखना चाहता है.
translations.pl: On chce przytrzymać drabinę, żeby się nie chwiała.
translations.el: Θέλει να κρατήσει τη σκάλα σταθερή.
translations.id: Dia ingin memegangi tangga agar tidak goyah.
translations.ro: Vrea să țină scara ca să nu se miște.
translations.cs: Chce podržet žebřík, aby se nekýval.
translations.da: Han vil holde stigen, så den står stabilt.
translations.ja: 彼ははしごをしっかり支えたい。

Feminine noun functioning as the accusative direct object.

sentences.target: Das Foto soll den Moment festhalten.

translations.de: Das Foto soll den Moment festhalten.
translations.en: The photo is meant to capture the moment.
translations.es: La foto busca capturar el momento.
translations.fr: La photo est censée saisir l’instant.
translations.zh-Hans: 这张照片是为了定格这一刻。
translations.pt: A foto é para captar o momento.
translations.vi: Bức ảnh nhằm ghi lại khoảnh khắc ấy.
translations.nl: De foto is bedoeld om het moment vast te leggen.
translations.hu: A fotó a pillanatot akarja megörökíteni.
translations.hi: यह फोटो उस पल को कैद करने के लिए है.
translations.el: Η φωτογραφία είναι για να αποτυπώσει τη στιγμή.
translations.nb: Bildet er ment å fange øyeblikket.
translations.id: Foto itu dimaksudkan untuk menangkap momen.
translations.sv: Fotot är tänkt att fånga ögonblicket.
translations.ro: Fotografia este menită să surprindă momentul.
translations.da: Fotoet er ment til at fange øjeblikket.
translations.ja: 写真はその瞬間を切り取るためのものだ。
